offering_description.value: Manufactures interlocking composite mats and sells or rents them to utilities, energy companies and contractors. It plans, installs and removes temporary access roads and work platforms at customer sites.

primary_products.value: Interlocking composite mats for temporary roads and work platforms

primary_services.value: Mat rental; site access planning; mat delivery, installation and removal

customer_segment.value: B2B: Electric utilities, infrastructure contractors, pipeline operators, oil and gas producers, and renewable energy developers

end_markets.value: Electric transmission and distribution; oil and gas; civil infrastructure; renewable energy

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Temporary use of composite mats; project or contract: Site access planning, installation and removal for infrastructure and energy projects; product sales: Outright purchases of composite mats
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; project or contract; product sales

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns polymer feedstock into composite mats for utilities, energy companies and contractors; service provider: Uses site plans and reusable mats to build temporary roads and work platforms for project owners and contractors; asset operator: Maintains a fleet of reusable composite mats for rental to utilities, energy companies and contractors
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: Operations in the United States and United Kingdom, with product sales to other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Composite mat manufacturing and sales, mat rental, and temporary site access services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct sales and project teams serving utilities, energy companies and contractors; own locations: Regional rental and service yards that dispatch mats and crews to customer sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA workplace safety rules and environmental requirements for manufacturing and field installation

notes: The full list of countries served and the extent of third-party distribution are uncertain.
